title: Not the fairest of them all
text:
Not the fairest of them all. I need this product for a small bathroom. The brown color and price are fair.

I am still waiting for it.
UPDATE 2023
Again this mirror looks awesome and from reviews of people it was as described. Unfortunately despite contact with the seller and Amazon for months, I never received it. So buyer beware. I do much of my shopping with Amazon and am mostly satisfied with the quality of products and deliveries. Hoping they take harsher action against the very few companies (most out of the United States) that do not deliver what they promise.
